ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky spearphish chain: HWP/LNK lure spawning mshta/PowerShell with BabyShark-style staging
ucs.description: Hunts Kimsuky's signature initial-access chain — weaponized HWP (Hangul) documents, ZIP-delivered LNK files, or ISO/CHM attachments that spawn mshta.exe, wscript.exe, or PowerShell to stage BabyShark/AppleSeed/ReconShark loaders. Pulls on Kimsuky's persistent reliance on Microsoft Office/HWP lures targeting Korean policy/foreign-affairs/journalist targets and their characteristic LOLBin chain (Office or Explorer → LNK/HWP → mshta/wscript/powershell → HTTP beacon).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hash values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("hwp.exe","Hwp.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","explorer.exe","7zFM.exe","WinRAR.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","hh.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*http*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*-enc *" OR Processes.process="*.hwp*" OR Processes.process="*.lnk*" OR Processes.process="*hta*" OR Processes.process="*WScript.Shell*" OR Processes.process="*.dotm*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host | eval kimsuky_score = if(match(parent_process_name,"(?i)hwp\.exe"),3,0) + if(match(process,"(?i)(downloadstring|iex|invoke-expression|-enc)"),2,0) + if(match(process,"(?i)\.(hwp|lnk|hta|chm|iso)"),2,0) | where kimsuky_score >= 2 | sort - _time
ucs.kql:
// Kimsuky (Velvet Chollima / APT43) — HWP/LNK lure → LOLBin staging
let Lookback = 14d;
let LureParents = dynamic(["hwp.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","explorer.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","hwordapp.exe"]);
let Stagers = dynamic(["mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","hh.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any (LureParents)
| where FileName has_any (Stagers)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "http://","https://","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression",
    "-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-ec ","WScript.Shell","ActiveXObject",
    ".hwp",".lnk",".hta",".chm",".iso",".dotm",".vbs",".js")
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?)\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = iff(isnotempty(B64), base64_decode_tostring(B64), "")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildProcess = FileName,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          Decoded, SHA256, ReportId
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Kimsuky — HWP/LNK → LOLBin chain via 4688
let Lookback = 14d;
let LureParents = dynamic(["hwp.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","explorer.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe"]);
let Stagers = dynamic(["mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","hh.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentBase = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildBase  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentBase in (LureParents)
| where ChildBase  in (Stagers)
| where CommandLine has_any (
    "http://","https://","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression",
    "-EncodedCommand","-enc ","WScript.Shell",".hwp",".lnk",".hta",
    ".chm",".iso",".dotm",".vbs",".js")
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentBase, ChildBase,
          ParentCmd = ParentProcessName, ChildCmd = CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky credential harvesting via reg.exe SAM/SYSTEM hive dump + scheduled-task persistence
ucs.description: Hunts Kimsuky's documented post-exploitation chain — `reg save HKLM\SAM` / `HKLM\SYSTEM` to a temp path (for offline NTLM extraction), paired with their characteristic scheduled-task and Run-key persistence using disguised task names (e.g. OneDrive, Edge, GoogleUpdate). Kimsuky operators favor built-in `reg.exe` / `schtasks.exe` / `wmic` over dropping Mimikatz, so this detection focuses on their LOLBin tradecraft rather than tool hashes.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("reg.exe","schtasks.exe","wmic.exe") AND ( (Processes.process_name="reg.exe" AND (Processes.process="*save*HKLM\\SAM*" OR Processes.process="*save*HKLM\\SYSTEM*" OR Processes.process="*save*HKLM\\SECURITY*" OR Processes.process="*save*hklm\\sam*")) OR (Processes.process_name="schtasks.exe" AND Processes.process="*/create*" AND (Processes.process="*OneDrive*" OR Processes.process="*GoogleUpdate*" OR Processes.process="*Edge*" OR Processes.process="*AdobeUpdate*" OR Processes.process="*WindowsUpdate*" OR Processes.process="*\\AppData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Public\\*")) ) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host | sort - _time
ucs.kql:
// Kimsuky — SAM/SYSTEM hive save + masqueraded scheduled-task persistence
let Lookback = 14d;
let SamDump = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "reg.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "save"
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)hklm\\(sam|system|security)\b"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Activity = "HiveDump",
              Cmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256;
let MasqTask = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "/create"
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)/tn\s+\S*(onedrive|googleupdate|edge|adobeupdate|chromeupdate|windowsupdate|defender|office)\S*"
       or  ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)/tr\s+\S*\\(appdata|programdata|users\\public|temp)\\"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Activity = "MasqueradedTask",
              Cmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256;
union SamDump, MasqTask
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Kimsuky — hive save + masqueraded schtasks via Windows 4688
let Lookback = 14d;
let Hive = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where tolower(NewProcessName) endswith "\\reg.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "save"
    | where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)hklm\\(sam|system|security)\b"
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              Activity = "HiveDump", CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
let Task = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where tolower(NewProcessName) endswith "\\schtasks.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "/create"
    | where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)/tn\s+\S*(onedrive|googleupdate|edge|adobeupdate|chromeupdate|windowsupdate|defender|office)\S*"
         or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)/tr\s+\S*\\(appdata|programdata|users\\public|temp)\\"
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              Activity = "MasqueradedTask", CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
union Hive, Task
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) ( (@Image:(*\reg.exe OR *\REG.EXE) @CommandLine:(*save* AND (*HKLM\SAM* OR *HKLM\SYSTEM* OR *HKLM\SECURITY* OR *hklm\sam* OR *hklm\system*))) OR (@Image:(*\schtasks.exe OR *\SCHTASKS.EXE) @CommandLine:(*\/create* AND (*OneDrive* OR *GoogleUpdate* OR *Edge* OR *AdobeUpdate* OR *ChromeUpdate* OR *WindowsUpdate* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\*))) )
ucs.rationale: CISA AA20-301A, KISA, and AhnLab reporting all repeatedly document Kimsuky's preference for `reg save` against SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY hives for offline credential extraction (vs. Mimikatz, which is heavier on EDR signatures), and their use of schtasks-created tasks named after legitimate updaters (OneDrive/GoogleUpdate/Edge) pointing to %AppData%/%ProgramData% payloads — both unusual for benign admin
